title: Brain Activity by Magnetoencephalography for Children
brief_summary: Investigate the differences in activation of brain networks during performing functional tasks for children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder with developmental delays and typical development
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder with development delays
* intelligence quotient 70 or greater

Exclusion Criteria:

* age less than 4 or greater than 10 of children
* intelligence quotient less than 70
study_population: Children diagnosed with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder with developmental delays, aged 4 to 10; and age-sex matched children with typical development
